offers_products.reason: Sells prescription OUD medicines: Suboxone sublingual film, Sublocade buprenorphine extended-release injection.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling pharmaceuticals; advocacy and education are not paid services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients with OUD are end users who receive and are prescribed Suboxone and Sublocade.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells through wholesalers, pharmacies, clinics and healthcare systems; payers and government programs are involved.

recurring_revenue.reason: Chronic OUD treatment means patients refill Suboxone and receive monthly Sublocade injections on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Medically necessary addiction treatment for a chronic disease; demand is not easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent prescription fills and monthly injections, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Pharmaceutical maker; customers pay for medicines, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Patients are the end users, and prescribers choose; main buyers are not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Specialty pharma with offices and research centers; manufacturing appears outsourced and the website doesn't show heavy plants.

notes: Large customers answer is uncertain: US wholesalers and government payers matter, but the website doesn't say so.
